title: Dendro G2 (v0.2.0): operator follows up from an R1 number to a cause and a decision
body:
Phase 0 — Dendro G2 (v0.2.0). Sponsor approved E1-E3 at 2026-10-10 18:57Z. PM decision: refine (staged).

Job Statement: When an R1 report shows me that something moved (rework is up, a seat is idle with work, a mission burned more), I want to ask the next question and the one after it without learning commands, flags or SQL, so I can reach the cause and a decision in one sitting.

Struggling moment (hypothesis, not yet observed): investigations stop at the first number. Follow-up needs CLI flags, SQL against the schema, or transcripts. #12 reports review-to-build rework as the largest token sink in exploratory analysis; R1 M3 shows that rework exists but not which pair, mission or period.

Observable outcome: P1 the operator goes from an R1 number to a named cause without SQL or schema knowledge; P2 every answer keeps the R1 AC7 trace; P3 G2 numbers equal R1 CLI numbers for the same rig and period; P4 unsupported questions get 'insufficient data' and the reason; P5 a review closes with a decision or explicit 'no change', later verified before/after.

Staging (sponsor decisions): E1 interface acceptance (#7, #14, #16, #17, #18) freezes only after one real R1 review session logs the operator's organic follow-up questions. E2 #12 (rework friction: pair-level breakdown of R1 M3, advisory thresholds) and #13 (sealed replay: two runs against the same cutoff manifest give identical totals; live sources read-only per AC12) proceed to Phase 1 now. E3 one primary interface in v0.2.0, chosen by evidence.

Constraints: all R1 constraints; reads the canonical R1 schema, no second schema; NL answers never exceed what data supports.
Anti-goals: no mutation of agent execution; no engagement metric as success; no second interface in v0.2.0; no prediction or simulation.

Release intent: v0.2.0, impact minor, local build, no publication. Entry: R1 merged.

References: docs/PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION_G2.md, docs/PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION.md, docs/ACCEPTANCE_R1.md, GitHub smota/dendro milestone v0.2.0, issue comments on #13.
